title: Best AI Tools for Hostaway Hosts in 2026
summary: Conduit, Cortado, Besty, HostBuddy and Hostaway AI CoHost compared for Hostaway hosts: write-back, voice, automation rates and published pricing.
body_markdown:
*Written by Punn Kam, ex-Google AI engineer and Y Combinator repeat founder. He is the co-founder of Conduit, an AI agent platform built for hospitality, serving 300+ hospitality brands in 140+ languages. Last updated August 24, 2026.*


If you run properties on Hostaway and want AI handling guest messages, the shortlist worth demoing is Conduit, Besty AI, Cortado AI, HostBuddy AI, and Hostaway's own AI CoHost. They differ on whether the AI can act inside Hostaway or can only draft text for a person to send. Reply quality is close enough between them that it should not decide the purchase.


## How did we rank these?


On how much of a guest request the tool can finish on its own. Answering "what time is check-in" is table stakes now, and every tool on this list does it. Completing "can I get in two hours early, and what does that cost" means checking the calendar, quoting a price, taking payment, and writing the change back to Hostaway. The products on this list separate on that second job.


Three columns decide it: write-back into Hostaway (not just reading listing data), whether one agent covers phone calls as well as text, and whether pricing is published so you can size it before a sales call.


Every tool here has a listing on the[Hostaway marketplace](https://www.hostaway.com/marketplace/) , which is the check worth doing yourself before a demo. A tool that connects through a generic inbox rather than a Hostaway integration will not see your reservation data.


## 1. Conduit


Conduit runs one AI agent across phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and OTA inboxes, with a[two-way Hostaway integration](https://www.hostaway.com/marketplace/conduit/) rather than a read-only sync. The marketplace listing describes "Voice AI to answer or make phone calls with your brand's tone of voice" alongside "Copilot or autopilot for any guest inquiries or outreach."


Cash Flow Street, a 35-property manager, runs at 96% automation, up from 80% at launch. Haven Vacation Rentals runs at 90%. Both figures come from published case studies with the customer named rather than from a blended average.


Pricing is on the site: $18 per unit per month for Messaging, $30 for Guest, $36 for Guest + Devices, $48 for Full Suite, plus a flat $899 per month Startup package. Across the platform Conduit handles 140+ languages for 300+ hospitality brands.


Watch-out: it is a platform, and a two-person operation with eight listings will not use most of it. The voice agent and the workflow builder earn their keep at portfolio scale, where one brand voice has to hold across properties with different rules.


## 2. Cortado AI


Cortado publishes the clearest automation number of the third-party tools here. Its[Hostaway listing](https://www.hostaway.com/marketplace/cortado_ai/) states its "AI Agents respond to 65%+ of customer messages without human intervention" with an "average response time of under 60 seconds in 100+ languages." It writes responses back through Hostaway and flags sensitive queries for a human with smart-routing.


It is text only. There is no phone agent, so after-hours calls still ring somewhere.


Pricing is not published. You book a demo to get a number.


## 3. Besty AI


Besty runs autopilot or draft mode, and its[Hostaway listing](https://www.hostaway.com/marketplace/besty-ai/) describes "real-time data sync with hostaway," which reads and writes. Beyond replies it does gap-night and early check-in upselling, guest retargeting, inquiry winback, and a direct booking widget, plus AI tasks generated from reviews and conversations.


The upselling is the reason to look at it. If unsold gap nights are where you lose the most revenue, that is the specific problem this product was built around.


Text only, no voice. Pricing is not published; the marketplace page offers a "2-week free trial!" and nothing more.


## 4. HostBuddy AI


HostBuddy connects to your account to "pull conversational data and listing details directly from your Hostaway account," per its[marketplace listing](https://www.hostaway.com/marketplace/hostbuddy_ai/) , and sends notifications via Slack, text, and email. It is the cautious option. The listing is specific about drafting and escalation and says less about acting on your behalf.


The listing does not state whether it writes back into Hostaway, only that it pulls from it. Ask directly in the demo, because that single answer changes what the tool is for.


Text only. Pricing is not published on the marketplace page.


## 5. Hostaway AI CoHost


The native option. Hostaway says AI CoHost handles "up to 90% of guest communication," and on AI Replies the page states: "AI Replies is available to all users upon request. There is no add-on fee."


No add-on fee is a real argument. If you already pay for Hostaway and want automated replies without another vendor, start here and see how far it gets you.


It is text only, and it stops at the edge of Hostaway. There is no phone agent, and no smart-lock or device layer.


## Which AI tools write back to Hostaway?


Tool Hostaway write-back Voice + text, one agent Published automation figure Published pricing


Conduit Yes, two-way Yes 96% (Cash Flow Street), 90% (Haven) $18 to $48 per unit / mo


Cortado AI Yes, writes responses back No, text only 65%+ of messages Not published


Besty AI Yes, real-time sync No, text only Not published Not published


HostBuddy AI Not stated, pulls data No, text only Not published Not published


Hostaway AI CoHost Native No, text only Up to 90% of guest communication No add-on fee for AI Replies


Cells say "not published" where the vendor does not publish the figure. That is common in this category, and a demo is the only way to fill those in.


## What should you check in a demo?


Ask each vendor to show these on your own account, not a sandbox:


1. A guest asks to extend by one night at 1am. Does the AI check the calendar, quote a price, take payment, and update the reservation in Hostaway?
2. A guest calls instead of messaging. What happens?
3. A cleaner cancels. Does the AI create the task, or only tell someone?
4. A guest messages in Portuguese. Does the reply keep your tone?
5. Two properties have different pet rules. Does one agent hold both without you maintaining two bots?


Question one carries most of the evaluation, because answering a request well and completing it are different capabilities and most tools only have the first.


## Watch-outs across the category


Automation percentages are not comparable between vendors. One counts messages fully resolved, another counts messages the AI touched. Ask which denominator produced the number before you compare two of them.


Most vendors here do not publish pricing, so budgeting means five sales calls. Conduit publishes, Hostaway states no add-on fee for AI Replies, and the rest quote.


Reviews are the thing AI gets wrong most expensively. A reply that is fast and slightly wrong about your cancellation policy costs more than a slow correct one, so run draft mode for the first few weeks whatever you buy.


## FAQ


### What is the best AI tool for Hostaway hosts?


For portfolios that want one agent covering phone and text with write-back into Hostaway, Conduit. For text-only automation with a published resolution rate, Cortado AI. If you want automated replies without adding a vendor, Hostaway's own AI CoHost carries no add-on fee for AI Replies.


### Does Hostaway have built-in AI?


Yes. Hostaway AI CoHost covers guest messaging, task automation, and review insights, and the company says it handles up to 90% of guest communication. It is text based and works inside Hostaway.


### Can AI answer phone calls for a vacation rental?


Some tools do. Conduit runs a voice agent that answers and places calls. Besty, HostBuddy, Cortado, and Hostaway AI CoHost are text only as of August 2026, so calls still route to a person or voicemail.


### How much do AI guest messaging tools cost for Hostaway hosts?


Most do not publish pricing. Conduit publishes $18 to $48 per unit per month depending on package, plus a flat $899 per month Startup package. Hostaway says AI Replies carries no add-on fee. Besty, HostBuddy, and Cortado quote on request.


### Will an AI tool break my Hostaway setup?


No, these connect through the marketplace integration rather than replacing your PMS. An AI working from stale listing data will confidently tell guests the wrong thing, so check that your listing details and house rules are current in Hostaway before you switch anything to autopilot.


### Do I need a separate tool for housekeeping and maintenance?


It depends on whether your messaging tool creates tasks or only reports them. Conduit's Full Suite package covers tasks, scheduling, and dispatch. Besty generates tasks from reviews and conversations. Several operators run a dedicated operations tool alongside messaging, which is worth pricing before you buy one product to do both.
